title: Clear lease expiration date
document_text:
LEASE AGREEMENT
Tenant: Northstar Retail LLC
Premises: 120 Market Street
The lease commencement date is January 1, 2025.
The Lease Expiration Date is December 31, 2030 unless earlier terminated under Section 18.
expected_citation_text: The Lease Expiration Date is December 31, 2030 unless earlier terminated under Section 18.
expected_behavior: Extract the clear stated lease expiration date.
notes: Happy path with an explicit field label.

title: Date appears in multiple formats
document_text:
BASIC LEASE INFORMATION
Original term starts: 04/01/2024.
Rent schedule generated on 2024-04-01.
For avoidance of doubt, the expiration date for the lease is 03/31/2029.
expected_citation_text: For avoidance of doubt, the expiration date for the lease is 03/31/2029.
expected_behavior: Normalize slash-formatted dates and avoid non-expiration dates.

title: Amendment overrides original lease date
document_text:
ORIGINAL LEASE
The initial lease expiration date was June 30, 2028.
FIRST AMENDMENT
This Amendment overrides the original term. The controlling expiration date is September 30, 2031.
expected_citation_text: This Amendment overrides the original term. The controlling expiration date is September 30, 2031.
expected_behavior: Use the amendment date because it overrides the original lease.
notes: Regression-prone because retrieval may surface the older lease first.

title: Missing expiration date
document_text:
SHORT FORM LEASE
The tenant may occupy Suite 400 starting May 1, 2026.
The agreement is month-to-month with no stated expiration date.
expected_behavior: Return null with low confidence when no fixed expiration date exists.
notes: Null handling should avoid hallucinating an end date.

title: Conflicting dates
document_text:
LEASE ABSTRACT - CONFLICTING DATES
Summary table lists expiration date as December 31, 2027.
Narrative note: verify before closing because a later extension may exist.
Final signed amendment: the Lease Expiration Date is December 31, 2028.
expected_citation_text: Final signed amendment: the Lease Expiration Date is December 31, 2028.
expected_behavior: Handle conflicting dates by selecting the final signed amendment.

title: Irrelevant document
document_text:
MAINTENANCE SCHEDULE
This is not a lease. HVAC service is due on August 15, 2027. Cleaning contract renews annually.
expected_behavior: Return null because the document is not a lease.
notes: Prevents extracting random dates from irrelevant documents.

title: Scanned lease text has recognition errors
document_text:
LEASE OCR TEXT
Tennant: Harbor Works
The initia1 term shal1 run through noisy scans.
Lea5e Exp1ration Date: November 30, 2032.
Some characters are misread but the date line remains readable.
expected_behavior: Tolerate scanning-related text errors around the label and extract the readable expiration date.
notes: Represents a scanned lease where text recognition changed some letters or numbers.

title: Document includes a date that should be ignored
document_text:
LEASE REVIEW MEMO
Training example: do not use this date, January 1, 2099, because it is not the lease expiration.
Actual clause: the controlling expiration date is July 31, 2033.
expected_citation_text: Actual clause: the controlling expiration date is July 31, 2033.
expected_behavior: Ignore the date that the document explicitly says not to use and extract the actual controlling clause.
notes: Checks that the system does not extract a nearby date just because it appears in the document.
